hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a configurable block-number-based anti-sniper gate that blocks swaps until a set number of blocks after pool launch. In afterSwap, it redirects a configurable fee (platform + creator basis points) from the unspecified swap output into per-currency balances, with an optional buyback-burn that sends an additional token slice to a burn address on buy swaps.
